detailed_description: Mesh Gradient Generator creates a CSS background from four editable radial-gradient color points. Use the browser color pickers and X/Y sliders to position each point, adjust the shared blur percentage, preview the background, randomize the point colors, and copy the generated CSS. It does not add or remove points, export images, animate gradients, or provide per-breakpoint responsive settings.
usage_steps: Choose colors for the four gradient points.
Move each point with its X and Y percentage sliders.
Adjust the shared blur slider for softer or sharper transitions.
Click Randomize to replace the point colors with preset choices.
Copy the generated CSS background code.
usage_examples: Create a CSS background for a hero section.
Draft a colorful card or panel background.
Copy a radial-gradient stack into a stylesheet for further editing.
